// ===========================================================================
// MOBILE-PLATFORM — the touch recognizer and the lifecycle pause.
//
// GENERATED. Do not edit this file. Its master is TypeScript, in
// tools/mobile-platform/src/, and tools/mobile-platform/README.md says how to
// re-derive it. RULE ZERO in CLAUDE.md: author at full quality, derive the
// shipped tier. The derivation needs TypeScript and esbuild, which is why they
// are not in package.json and why the OUTPUT is what this repository carries —
// nothing a player loads depends on a toolchain being installed.
//
// It is one IIFE assigning one global, `MobilePlatform`, because build.cjs
// concatenates js/*.js into a single <script> in one shared scope: a module is
// the one shape that cannot join it, and a closure is the one shape that can
// without putting 30 more names into a scope where a collision is a black page.
//
// WHAT IT IS. A pointer-event state machine (PENDING -> DRAGGING / LONGPRESSED
// / PAN) that emits SEMANTIC gestures — tap, longPress, longPressEnd, drag,
// pan, pinchStep, cancel — instead of synthesising mouse events, plus the
// two-state pause (hidden AND blur) that the web gets wrong by treating them as
// one. Ported from the GeneralsX iOS layer.
//
// WHAT IT IS NOT, YET. Nothing in this game calls it. js/touch.js is still the
// on-screen controller and tests/tap.cjs still measures that. This file ships
// so the wiring is a decision rather than an import, and tests/mobile-platform.cjs
// measures it in the built page so it cannot rot while it waits.
//
// Three defects were found and fixed before it was committed, each by running
// it rather than reading it; tests/mobile-platform.cjs holds all three as
// regressions. See tools/mobile-platform/CHANGES.md.
// ===========================================================================
